data.exact_reserve_text: The syndicate also benefitted from prior year releases of $4.3m (2014: $4.1m), which was a reflection of the continued low level of insured natural catastrophe losses incurred in the past 2 years.

named_events.event_name: Explosions in the Chinese port of Tianjin
named_events.loss_description: The syndicate's largest loss to date on the 2015 underwriting year relates to the explosions in the Chinese port of Tianjin. However this loss is well within our catastrophe margin.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2015 with gross claims outstanding of $25.112m. During 2015 the syndicate recorded prior year releases of $4.3m, driven primarily by continued low insured natural catastrophe activity which produced favourable prior-year development. The movement is reported as a release (favourable development) and is described in the managing agent's strategic report.
raw_causal_phrases: prior year releases of $4.3m (2014: $4.1m), which was a reflection of the continued low level of insured natural catastrophe losses incurred in the past 2 years.
Aided by another year of relatively low natural catastrophe activity, syndicate 6107 achieved a claims ratio of 49% (2014: 42%).
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year movement: only a NET prior year release of $4.3m is explicitly stated in the narrative. No GROSS prior-year movement figure was provided in a dedicated 'movement in prior year provision' table; therefore the NET figure from the strategic report narrative was used. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from balance sheet (Claims outstanding, gross) as at 1 January 2015. All amounts are reported in the syndicate's functional currency (USD). The claims development triangle in note 9 provides current gross claims liabilities by underwriting year but lacks full multi-period development rows to compute gross PYD reliably; triangle usage was therefore limited.
